name: Workflow Deck
description: Create independent experiment, feature, tooling, PR and branch-cleanup tasks. Detach or minimize the panel.
whenToUse: Starting experiments, developing features or tools, submitting pull requests, or cleaning up branches.

get_workflows.description: List the five workflow entries and their referenced files or Skill. Read-only: does not create or run a task. Users launch independent tasks with the panel buttons.
